catalyst_text: Reported positive interim Phase 2a psoriasis trial results
detailed_catalyst_text: Positive interim data from a randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2a study in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis showed high rates of skin clearance, including 63.5% achieving PASI 100 at Week 16. Safety was favorable and similar to placebo, with no serious treatment-emergent adverse events reported. These results suggest strong efficacy and tolerability that could be competitive within the IL-23p19 class.
catalyst_text_evidence: MENLO PARK, Calif., 2026-04-27 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. ("Oruka") (NASDAQ:ORKA), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel biologics designed to set a new standard for the treatment of chronic skin diseases, today announced positive interim results from its EVERLAST-A Phase 2a trial of ORKA-001, a novel half-life extended IL-23p19 monoclonal antibody, in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis. 40 of 63 participants (63.5%) treated with ORKA-001 achieved the primary endpoint of PASI 100 at Week 16, representing complete skin clearance. Identical results were observed for IGA 0. Other key secondary endpoints included PASI 90 at Week 16, achieved by 83% of participants, and IGA 0/1 at Week 16, achieved by 84% of participants. ORKA-001 was well tolerated with a safety profile similar to placebo and consistent with prior IL-23p19 inhibitors. There were no serious treatment-emergent adverse events ("TEAEs") and one severe TEAE, which occurred in the placebo group.

catalyst_text: Dosed first patients in Phase 2b psoriasis trial
detailed_catalyst_text: First patients were dosed in the EVERLAST-B Phase 2b trial in December 2025, marking initiation of mid-stage development in plaque psoriasis. The study is evaluating multiple induction dose levels with PASI 100 at Week 16 as the primary endpoint. This milestone confirms trial start and progression of the program.
catalyst_text_evidence: First patients dosed in EVERLAST-B Phase 2b trial of ORKA-001 in December 2025 with data expected in 2027. The first patients were dosed in EVERLAST-B in December 2025, and enrollment is ongoing.

catalyst_text: Announced positive interim Phase 1 results in volunteers
detailed_catalyst_text: Interim Phase 1 healthy volunteer data were reported, showing a very long half-life and favorable safety profile. These findings support the program’s potential to enable infrequent maintenance dosing for psoriasis and hidradenitis suppurativa. The results strengthen the clinical rationale to advance into patient studies.
catalyst_text_evidence: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:ORKA)... today announced positive interim data from its Phase 1 trial of ORKA-002. PK: ORKA-002 showed a half-life of 75-80 days, greater than three times that of bimekizumab, and a comparable Cmax to bimekizumab at equivalent doses based on previously reported bimekizumab data. Safety: ORKA-002 was well tolerated at all dose levels, with a favorable safety profile consistent with the anti-IL-17 class. There were no severe treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) or serious adverse events, and no discontinuations.
